name: read_book
text: A person stands holding an open book in both hands at lower chest height and reads it quietly. The hands support the two lower corners of the book about thirty centimeters apart, elbows bent down by the ribs. Tilt the head down to look at the pages. Keep holding the open book steadily with small natural weight shifts.

review.notes_zh: 双手抬起至胸前持书并低头阅读，手距约15至18厘米、无双手交叉；首版仰头，改用已验收低头动作的头部朝向约束重新生成。已另配held_book_open，双握点间距16厘米；合书held_book保留。
